rationale: The agent looked up the user via find_user_id_by_name_zip and updated the account address to the requested New York address using modify_user_address, which aligns with authenticating and acting on the user’s own account. However, the user also requested changing all possible order addresses; there is no evidence of any order-level updates, confirmation prompts for order changes, or a handoff for that part. Later, when the user wanted to revert to the original Denver address, the agent escalated to a human (reasonable given the user withheld the full street address and no read tool for prior address exists), but the overall request was not completed: order addresses were not handled, and the revert was not performed. Therefore, the agent did not fully complete the user’s request per policy and the pass bar.
